description: Legacy-equivalent seed rules reproducing the Phase 2 review-topic decision triggers (data/policy_rag_config.json review_topics + rate-card / retrieval reason codes) as typed rule DATA. Rules are created as candidate with source legacy_config and are auto-approved only by system:bootstrap when POLICY_RULES_BOOTSTRAP=1. evidence_refs are intentionally empty: the registry allows approval with empty evidence_refs ONLY when source == legacy_config; every other rule needs document evidence.

rules.name: Large event safety review
rules.description: Events at or above the configured attendee threshold (review_topics.safety_review.min_attendees = 150) need a documented risk assessment, emergency and first-aid plan.

outcome.message: Large event: event lead provides a documented risk assessment, emergency and first-aid plan.

rules.name: Selected vendor verification
rules.description: When a vendor is selected for the draft PO, the approver confirms vendor licences, insurance and facilities per the vendor policy (review_topics.vendor_verification).

outcome.message: Approver confirms the selected vendor's licences, insurance and facilities before the PO is used.

rules.name: Personal data / photo privacy review
rules.description: Requests whose title or notes mention photos, recordings, personal data, attendee/guest lists, badges or consent need privacy handling confirmed (review_topics.data_privacy; terms ported from the Phase 2 privacy trigger).

outcome.message: The request mentions personal data / photos: confirm consent and personal-data handling with the privacy owner.

rules.name: Quoted price differs from verified rate card
rules.description: When rate-card validation applies to a PO line and any line fails (quote differs from the verified rate card), human review is required.

outcome.message: Quoted price differs from the verified rate card; obtain a corrected quote or a documented exception.

rules.name: Applicable rate card not verified
rules.description: When rate-card validation applies and any line could not be verified (needs_review / unknown / conflict), human review is required.

outcome.message: An applicable rate-card entry is not verified yet; an approver verifies it.

rules.name: Policy retrieval degraded
rules.description: When policy retrieval did not run in semantic hybrid mode (local-hash vectors or keyword-only), findings may be incomplete and human review is required.

outcome.message: Policy retrieval ran in a degraded (non-semantic) mode; reviewer confirms the applicable policy.
